title: Chapter 334 All Trivia
content:
Chapter 334 All Trivia

Facing Chen Yu's request, Lu Daosheng did not pay any attention.

"The next thing we have to deal with is the matter of the Palace of Nothingness."

Hearing this, the powerful people in the Void Palace couldn't help but feel excited.

The Lord of the Xuwu Palace, Xu Wuzi, looked even pale and sweated coldly.

With a plop.

Under the shocked gaze of everyone present, Xu Wuzi knelt directly at Lu Daosheng and burst into tears and said, "Sir, I, Xu Wu Palace, have no idea of being an enemy of you."

He was very scared now.

So much so that he didn't use his brain at all.

If he calmed down, he would find that Lu Daosheng did not refer to this matter.

"No?"

"Absolutely not!"

"Then do you think that Chen Yu alone can really do this and control the power of nothingness. Tell me, no?"

At this moment, Xu Wuzi was completely stunned.

Just thinking about it for a moment, he knew that there was someone in his Void Palace who was the backer of Chen Yu.

"Ah!! Who is it?!"

"Get out of here!!"

Suddenly, Xu Wuzi was completely angry. He almost roared and glared at all the people present at Xu Wu Palace.

Even though he was still kneeling, the terrifying aura still made everyone present tremble.

This is the anger of a lord of the power of order.

No one could withstand the field except Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Chen Yu slightly.

When Chen Yu noticed Lu Daosheng's gaze, he actually showed a faint smile, but with his painful and distorted face, he looked extremely creepy.

"Kill me, I'll tell you if I kill me."

Hearing Chen Yu's words, Lu Daosheng sneered, "Now, you are useless."

"Because, I can know everything."

Buzz —

As Lu Daosheng's palm spread out, a mysterious world suddenly appeared in front of everyone in a vortex shape.

"This is endless hell, and next, you will enjoy endless torture in it."

"Don't worry, you won't die."

At this time, a powerful attraction came from the vortex, and in an instant, Chen Yu was forcibly sucked in.

At this moment, Chen Yu was still thinking about negotiating terms with Lu Daosheng, which was simply a fool.

The torture of eternal life is his ultimate belonging.

"Xu Xin."

After dealing with Chen Yu, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at the people in the Void Palace and spoke calmly.

The next moment.

Before everyone could react, a figure knelt in front of Lu Daosheng with a plop.

"Sir, please spare me!"

Seeing Xu Xin, the people in Xu Wu Palace were immediately angry.

Xu Wuzi, who was kneeling beside him, roared directly at Xu Xin and said, "Xu Xin, you **, do you want to kill the entire Xu Wu Palace?!"

Facing Xu Wuzi's anger, Xu Xin's face turned miserable.

He knew that he lost the king.

The bet was wrong.

At this moment, he only had regret in his heart, although he knew that it was meaningless.

Looking at Xu Xin who was still thinking of begging for mercy, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, "What should I do? It's up to you to decide for yourself in the Xuwu Palace."

Lu Daosheng looked at Xu Wuzi Dao beside Xu Xin.

Upon hearing this, Xu Wuzi was shocked and quickly stood up.

"Sir, I know."

laugh!

A terrifying power of nothingness condensed from Xu Wuzi's hand. The next moment, Xu Wuzi pierced Xu Xin's chest with one hand.

It can be said to be clean and neat.

"Lord of the Palace, you,"

Xu Xin's eyes widened, and finally his body slowly dissipated.

Now, Xu Xin will never have any next life.

One blow directly cut off his reincarnation.

In this regard, all the small problems were perfectly solved by Lu Daosheng.

That's right, these are just some small problems for Lu Daosheng.

As Lu Daosheng walked further and further, he felt more and more that there seemed to be a breath in this world guiding him.

Search for the truth of the world!

For some reason, this sentence suddenly appeared in Lu Daosheng's mind.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng's face was covered with a layer of solemnity.

From his current perspective, if one person wants to know some clues, it is very consistent with one person.

Venerable Wuji.

You know, he is known as the Creator.

He also created the five major order halls.

I think that the old man must have a unique understanding of the world.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng had decided to visit him.

As for the other side of the starry sky, Lu Daosheng pondered a little.

The strength of the other side of the starry sky is far superior to other regions. For example, the Dao Realm of the Wutuo clan leader, is only barely qualified on the other side of the starry sky.

After breaking through the Tao realm, you will understand the mystery of the source.

Once you understand thoroughly, you can master the power of the source.

This is the Qiyuan Realm.

As the realm of the source of cultivation reaches the critical point and the strength reaches a higher level, it becomes the realm of the origin.

The control of the source can reach a perfect level, which is many times stronger than the Qiyuan Realm.

When you reach the Origin Realm, you can call it a strong man on the other side of the starry sky.

It seems that the Lord of the Dome Heavenly Palace and the Lord of other major forces are basically in the Origin Realm.

Of course, the highest combat power on the other side of the starry sky is naturally not as simple as the surface.

There is also a realm above the original realm.

Langcang Mountain, the ancestor of the Dome Heavenly Palace, was above the Origin Realm.

The power of the source in the body is completely sublimated, making its own power endless, and this is boundless.

When you reach the borderless, you can look at the entire starry sky and be invincible.

There is an unwritten rule on the other side of the starry sky. If there is no major crisis, strong people without borders cannot take action.

Otherwise, you will face siege from other borderless powerful men.

At that time, we will have to become a state of burning both jade and stone.

It can be imagined that there is no border on the other side of the starry sky.

If Chen Yu had not broken common sense and mastered one of the supreme powers of nothingness, he would have never been able to kill a borderless powerful man like Langcangshan.

Later, Langcang Mountain broke through again.

The boundless power is completely unified and transformed into a state of return.

It is no exaggeration to say that if the power of order does not come out, Langcang Mountain is completely invincible in the world.

Of course, except for the deserted city.

Now, due to Lu Daosheng's intervention, the strength of the other side of the starry sky has undoubtedly broken the shackles of the past, and even the powerful people in the Guiyi Realm have appeared.

Then he didn't mind accepting such a considerable power.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng's palm was facing upwards, and a small city like a model appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng threw himself into the distance.

A boom!

The huge city appeared in everyone's eyes.

Shocked, feared, excited, everyone looked at the giant city in the distance.

At this time, my mind was so fast that I had already reacted.

A plop!

An old man knelt down to Lu Daosheng first.

"Sir, I am willing to lead the entire Dome Heavenly Palace to officially incorporate it into your army!"
